entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: An ancient time mage who has lost his spark and lives quietly, whose past is shown as he meets Subira, survives an assassination plot and later raises a daughter.

entities.name: Subira
entities.description: A caravan master who suspects then defends Teferi, later becoming Niambi's mother.

entities.name: Kwende
entities.description: A warrior descended from Mageta the Lion who stages a murder and sandstorm to kill Teferi out of Zhalfir vengeance.

entities.name: Maket
entities.description: A pilgrim murdered and preserved by death magic to frame Teferi.

entities.name: Mageta the Lion
entities.description: Kwende's ancestor, a general who was in Ki'pamu when Zhalfir was removed.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The artificer who created powerful artifacts that might help restore Zhalfir.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A nation partially removed from Dominaria by Teferi, whose ghostly coastline is visible from the beach.

entities.name: Sewa
entities.description: A Femeref town serving Zhalfir pilgrims.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: The city Maket supposedly traveled from.

entities.name: Ki'pamu
entities.description: A place Kwende says Teferi destroyed.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The land whose rift Teferi repaired at the cost of his spark.

entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: The mage academy where some know who Teferi is.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A cult rumored to be gaining strength outside Otaria.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: An event several years before this scene after which Teferi wandered.

entities.name: Zhalfir time rift
entities.description: The rift Teferi created that removed Zhalfir from the world.

events.summary: Teferi, living quietly as a scholar, goes to the beach at dawn to see Zhalfir's ghostly coastline.
events.quote: Teferi walked out to the beach before dawn, to where he could see Zhalfir reflected in the sunrise.

events.summary: Teferi recalls wandering Dominaria since the Mending, unsettled by his guilt over Zhalfir.
events.quote: He had been wandering for the past several years, since the Mending

events.summary: Teferi questions whether his decision to hide Zhalfir was self-serving.
events.quote: Teferi wasn't sure why Zhalfir had been so much on his mind since he'd given up his spark.

events.summary: Subira and Kwende confront Teferi outside his hostel, naming him.
events.quote: They say in the market that you're called Teferi.

events.summary: Subira reveals a man named Maket who was coming to see Teferi is dead.
events.quote: He's dead.

events.summary: Kwende says Maket's body shows no sign of rot after two days.
events.quote: Because it's been two days and his body is not showing any sign of rot.

events.summary: Teferi examines Maket and finds an unnatural death spell disguised as time magic.
events.quote: You and your physician were right, this isn't a natural death.

events.summary: Teferi tells them he did not kill Maket.
events.quote: Luckily for our burgeoning friendship, I did not.

events.summary: Subira guesses he is the Teferi who destroyed Zhalfir, and accepts it.
events.quote: I think you're not just a Teferi, but the Teferi.

events.summary: Teferi admits to Subira he questions his decision every day.
events.quote: When I created the Zhalfir rift, I was so certain I was right

events.summary: A giant sandstorm rolls toward the caravan and Sewa.
events.quote: Rolling toward them out of the desert flats was a sandstorm.

events.summary: Teferi stretches a time bubble to deflect the storm, exhausting his powers.
events.quote: He cast the spell to stop time for a bubble of air ten feet in front of him.

events.summary: The bubble collapses and Teferi survives the weakened storm.
events.quote: Then he hit the ground and the bubble collapsed.

events.summary: A drover reports magistrates are coming to accuse Teferi of raising the storm.
events.quote: They say someone here brought the storm.

events.summary: Teferi realizes Kwende framed him and sent the storm.
events.quote: It was clear as glass now.

events.summary: Kwende ambushes Teferi with a sword, which Teferi rusts with accelerated time.
events.quote: The sword swing came out of nowhere and Teferi flung himself sideways.

events.summary: Kwende confesses he hired a mage to cause the storm and the poison.
events.quote: I hired a mage to make the spells that stirred the winds, and to make the death magic poison

events.summary: Kwende reveals he is descended from Mageta the Lion.
events.quote: My ancestor was Mageta the Lion.

events.summary: Subira lashes Kwende's arm with her whip and calls him the murderer.
events.quote: You are the murderer!

events.summary: Teferi tells Kwende Zhalfir is not destroyed and he would restore it if he could.
events.quote: Zhalfir is not destroyed!

events.summary: Subira dares Kwende to kill her to stop her from taking Teferi away.
events.quote: Then kill me. That's the only way you'll stop me.

events.summary: Kwende backs away and Subira drives Teferi off in her wagon.
events.quote: Kwende stared at her as the moment stretched, then he slowly stepped back.

events.summary: Teferi agrees to travel with Subira's caravan for a while.
events.quote: For a while,

events.summary: Years later Subira settles down with Teferi and they raise Niambi.
events.quote: A few years ago, Subira had found someone else to run her caravan, and she had settled down with Teferi

events.summary: Teferi freezes Niambi mid-fall by instinct.
events.quote: Teferi cast the spell out of pure instinct and Niambi froze in mid-air.

events.summary: Teferi reflects that he cannot trade freedom for safety, resolving to search for a way to return Zhalfir.
events.quote: Urza had certainly created powerful artifacts that might help.

events.summary: Teferi releases the spell and catches Niambi.
events.quote: As time moved around her again, she landed in her father's arms and laughed with delight.

relations.note: They settle down together and have a daughter.
relations.quote: she had settled down with Teferi in this town near one of their old routes, long enough to have Niambi.
He is the destroyer of Zhalfir!
My ancestor was Mageta the Lion.

relations.note: Akime is one of her drovers.
relations.quote: her drover Akime ran to help

relations.note: Subira accuses Kwende of Maket's murder.
